_about: Lists used by the encounter generator.
situations: The monsters are fighting each other when the party arrives.
A Normal-rank farmer is hiding nearby and needs rescue.
Another Iron-rank team is already here and wants the kill.
The monsters are guarding a fresh spawn point thick with magic.
Fog or reeds limit sight to 30 feet.
A coin-farm patrol is overdue and these monsters are why.
The ground is unstable; a failed check drops someone into water.
A Church of Purity zealot is watching how the party fights.
The monsters are unusually strong; the local magic is rising.
